assumptions.choice: Trigger the monthly logic on the bar whose (year, month) differs from the previous bar's (year, month), including the very first bar the strategy processes.
assumptions.reason: The feed provides only daily OHLCV bars with no explicit month-start flag, so the first-trading-day-of-month must be inferred from the bar date; this is the standard literal reading of 'first bar of the month' for a daily feed.

assumptions.choice: Use self.order_target_percent(target=w) to size/adjust the position to the computed weight w of current portfolio value, and self.close() when the filter is active.
assumptions.reason: The spec states 'target weight' and 'rebalance to this weight' as fractions of capital; order_target_percent is backtrader's direct primitive for targeting a percentage of portfolio value, and self.close() is the canonical mapping for 'close the position' when the filter fires.
Spec states '> 2%' verbatim; implemented as a strict inequality with 0.02 as the decimal threshold.

assumptions.choice: Track a single self.order attribute, skip issuing a new order if one is pending, and reset it in notify_order on Completed/Canceled/Margin/Rejected.
assumptions.reason: Canonical default for guarding overlapping orders; prevents duplicate submissions if a monthly order has not yet filled when the next trigger bar is evaluated.
